scope: offline research, phase 2; no production promotion, deployment or orders
sequence: execute benchmarks and controlled legacy ablations
execute base search without protective overlays
execute chronological OOS and separate overlay comparisons
legacy_scope: The failed phase-1 causal research policies, not a claim to have reconstructed the separate live production strategy.
engine: Reuse phase-1 accounting, event paths, admission, costs, margin, fills and summary; expose a causal target/resize controller. Default-controller output must exactly equal the original engine.
diagnostics: Exact additive event log-growth/cost/turnover attribution. Asset, timing, stop and resize counterfactuals are separate non-additive path-dependent replays, never an oracle opportunity estimate.
calendar_months: 30/90/180/365 calendar-day lookbacks, explicitly approximating 1/3/6/12 months on a 365-day crypto market.
separation: Six independent mode/cap partitions: robust 1.25 and aggressive 1.25/1.5/2/2.5/3; no sharing of validation winners between partitions.
oos_integrity: All annual choices use only the preceding calendar year's validation and fixed tie-breaks. History was already researched in phase 1; algorithmic chronological OOS is not untouched scientific OOS or sealed history.
fills: Signal from completed UTC day D is assumed available D+1 00:00:01; daily data therefore permits D+2 open, not D+1 open. Extra-entry-bar stress uses D+3 with frozen entry intent. No fabricated intraday D+1 fills.
overlays: First select a profitable no-overlay base using prior validation only; compare NONE, catastrophe ATR4, trail ATR3, TP25 and TP50 plus trail ATR3. These paired diagnostics never retroactively change base selection.
seal: No pristine historical seal. Finalists, if any, remain forward-evaluation research hypotheses; no successful A without actual sealed evidence.
outputs: research/phase2_20260926 only; protected production data/outputs/app/automation remain untouched
